prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / style-transfer. Create a finished wide 1882 x 836 banner for the "ROYAL ARRIVAL" rewards campaign.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCE: bold orange, petrol-cyan and near-black Japanese anime music-poster artwork, a close-up adult headphone-wearing character with short dark tousled hair, a visible cyan-toned eye, heavy black brush shadows, black technical streetwear, scratched screen-print texture, halftone and stencil graphic fragments. Adapt this striking editorial art direction into a horizontal banner. Keep the illustrated headphone character in a dynamic close-up occupying the right 52%, head at an angle, eye and orange/cyan headphone earcup clearly readable. Do not bring in any other campaign's characters, fantasy crowns, coins, or royal robes.
Backdrop: a continuous vivid burnt-orange, deep-cyan and black printed poster surface, with sharp diagonal paint slashes, carefully placed stencil/halftone and restrained distressed marks. The art should feel intentional and graphic, with clean focal details rather than noisy visual clutter. Orange and cream copy area at left; cyan/black character at right; orange headphone accents connect the two halves. No frames or separate rectangular panels.
Only readable campaign text:
"ROYAL" on the first line and "ARRIVAL" on the second, huge heavy condensed uppercase at upper-left.
"APPROX. TOTAL REWARDS" as a smaller clear qualifier immediately above the amount.
"₱16,000" as a very large dominant ONE-LINE amount below.
Use off-white/ivory letters and numerals with dark ink edging where needed, sharp strong hierarchy, slightly dynamic editorial slant. Keep all words fully legible at mobile width; the amount includes a Philippine peso sign, comma and exact digits 1 6 0 0 0. This user-approved rounded promotional total summarizes 28 tasks; do not add a task table or any other text. Keep copy within the left 46%, at least 60px from canvas edges, no text across the face. Preserve bottom-right corner safe space for carousel dots.
No reference-page words such as DIGITAL/LENS, no logos, no watermark, no extra slogans, no dates, no UI buttons, no glossy 3D or soft gold effects. Premium graphic anime print campaign, clean crisp character linework, high contrast and controlled screen-print grain.
rounding: User requested 16,000 for the banner; task rewards remain unchanged.
